mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the drive wheel was the most interesting individual step because its gear met the brush gear. The whole project was worthwhile as a simple way to see how a crumb sweeper fits together.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the second wheel was the least interesting individual step: it went exactly where expected and added little to my understanding. The finished sweeper still has a clear purpose.

surprise.text: The final description connected the parts by explaining how the turning gears and brush move crumbs into the hopper.

arbitrary.text: No action seemed unnecessary for assembling the sweeper, although following the prescribed fittings required little decision-making.

continue.text: I like the idea of the finished sweeper, but I would not choose another chapter of similar assembly: the steps were mostly predictable and mechanical.
